command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=$(python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/state/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json')
print(json.loads(p.read_text())['repo_root'])
PY
)
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega-final-wiring-XXXXXX)
cp -a "$ROOT/." "$TMP/"
python3 - "$TMP" <<'PY'
import pathlib, sys
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
p=root/'omega/supervisor_outer.py'
s=p.read_text()
needle='    "relay": [sys.executable, "-m", "omega.relay_entrypoint"],\n'
insert=needle+'    "receipt_reconciler": [sys.executable, "-m", "omega.receipt_reconciler"],\n'
if '

' not in s:
    if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('PATCH_NEEDLE_MISSING')
    p.write_text(s.replace(needle,insert,1))
PY
cd "$TMP"
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_receipt_reconciler.py tests/test_receipt_reconciler_atomic.py tests/test_relay_entrypoint.py tests/test_777_central_spool_runtime.py
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from omega.supervisor_outer import CHILDREN, Supervisor
assert CHILDREN['receipt_reconciler'][1:] == ['-m','omega.receipt_reconciler']
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    base=pathlib.Path(td); s=Supervisor(base/'state', base/'release'); env=s.child_env()
    assert env['OMEGA_CARRIER_REPO']==str(base/'carrier_repo')
    assert env['OMEGA_UNIFIED_DB']==str(base/'data'/'omega_unified.db')
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','receipt_reconciler_child':CHILDREN['receipt_reconciler'],'no_live_runtime_mutation':True},sort_keys=True))
PY
rm -rf "$TMP"
